content.overview: Article 32 is the Supreme Court gateway for PIL to enforce Part III fundamental rights; liberalised standing does not enlarge Article 32 into a general public-law jurisdiction beyond fundamental rights.
content.study: PIL is a rule of standing, not a new writ. Under Article 32 the claim must still concern enforcement of fundamental rights. Use this forum for Part III violations affecting large or disadvantaged classes; use Article 226 in the High Court where the grievance is wider public-law wrong or territorial convenience so requires. Private disputes dressed as PIL fail. Cross-read the constitutional Article 32 topic for the writ power itself.
